# TS9802

> **Reserved: not currently emitted by the compiler.** This code is catalogued, but no
> typesugar check reports it yet. If your build fails, look up the code it actually prints.

**Category:** Operators · **Severity:** Error

## Message

```
Operator '{operator}' is handled by the preprocessor and cannot be registered with @operator
```

## Explanation

Custom operators like |&gt;, ::, and &lt;| are transformed at the lexical level by the preprocessor.

They cannot be registered with @operator because @operator is for standard JavaScript operators.

To overload an operator for your own type:
- Annotate a typeclass method with @op (e.g. /** @op + */ add(b: A): A)
- Provide an instance (/** @impl Typeclass&lt;Type&gt; */ or @derive) so the transformer can resolve the operator to that method
